source_scope: Exact 82 existing first-party CC0 claim-backed Q-P-Q facts from F32/F35/F39 archive; no external or protected source; no novel-world evaluation
question: Can a reversible, exactly indexed native-independent Q-P-Q coordinate substrate outperform the F41 bit-filter in both precision and encoded coordinate bytes on identical known facts, with deterministic cold restore, incrementality and deletion?
hypothesis: The archived 82 Q-P-Q edges can be encoded losslessly with byte-local indices and complete dictionary accounting in fewer than 984 raw-coordinate bytes, with zero false-positive membership/composition queries and exact reproducibility on Linux and Windows.
control_groups: Raw exact triple tuples serialized as uint32 little-endian subject,predicate,object at 82*12=984 bytes (source labels/receipts excluded in both)
Exact source graph adjacency with same known edges and bounded candidate domains; zero false positives is the hard correctness ceiling
F41 source-exact 3-hash Bloom family remains frozen negative; do not rerun or retune its mechanism
Empty snapshot and deterministic tampered-checksum, malformed header, duplicate row, out-of-range ordinal, noncanonical reordering negative controls

encoding_contract.header: magic 4 bytes, q_count uint8, p_count uint8, triple_count uint16 little endian = 8 total header bytes
encoding_contract.vocabulary: Sorted positive numeric QIDs and PIDs, each uint32 little-endian, 78 Q plus 8 P = 344 bytes; included in payload
encoding_contract.triples: Sorted unique numeric (subject,predicate,object); one uint8 index per field = 3 bytes per triple = 246 bytes
encoding_contract.digest: SHA256 trailer of entire header/vocabulary/triples = 32 bytes; reject a mismatch
encoding_contract.count_source_receipts: Compare separately and identically to raw control; neither numeric representation includes labels, provenance, graph construction or acquisition in its 630/984 coordinate format

evaluation.domain: All 78 observed QIDs, all 8 observed PID values, all 10 root × first PID × second PID × terminal QID two-hop candidates (49,920 total); and 78×8×78 direct membership candidates (48,672 total)
evaluation.old_then_new: Freeze shared Q/P vocabulary from already-known 82 source archive, encode/cold restore old 33 before append 49, then encode/cold restore all 82, check original edges retained, no duplicates or surprises
evaluation.deletion: Choose lexicographically smallest numeric source triple after all updates, delete once, snapshot/restore, verify one missing triple and all 81 others identical, then re-add and restore; this is development mechanics, not source truth revision
metrics: Payload bytes incl complete coordinate dictionary/checksum
Raw coordinate bytes for exact typed uint32 triplets, same source scope
Membership confusion TP FP FN TN over fixed bounded archive domain
Twohop confusion TP FP FN TN over 49,920 bounded archive queries
Incremental original/new retention, exact canonical cold reencode and parity
Explicit shared source-archive provenance bytes for honest inclusive footprint; use source archive lengths as identical shared external costs
Wall time only exploratory, never a performance qualification

limitations: This is a lossless numeric graph index, not a neural recipient, learned association mechanism, semantic labels, causal reasoning, novel world generalization, full provenance-bearing model, or even guaranteed meaningful whole-process savings. Exact graph symbolic control remains equally accurate.
classification: DEV_EXACT_INDEX_ENCODE_ONLY; SCIENTIFIC_PASS=false until independently authorized and frozen native recipient/strong fully trained control tests
